adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `hubspotRefreshToken` is assigned from `refreshOAuthTokens(...)` and typed/used as a `HubspotToken`. But `refreshOAuthTokens` (new in `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`) returns a raw `fetch(...)` `Response` object when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` (sync mode). No `.json()` parsing/mapping occurs in `refreshOAuthTokens`, so in sync mode `hubspotRefreshToken` will be a `Response`, not an object with token fields like `accessToken`/`expiresIn`; any subsequent code that reads those fields will see `undefined` and likely compute an invalid expiry / persist bad credentials.
